prompt: The attached image shows three approved crypt floor tiles: match their palette (bone #E6DFCF, soot #17151A, warm greys), values and painterly low-detail style. Create ONE square 1:1 sprite atlas of 16 FLOOR DECALS seen strictly from straight above (orthographic top-down, lying flat on the floor), arranged in an invisible 4 x 4 grid of equal cells, one decal centred in each cell, each filling about 70 percent of its cell. Row 2: three different pools of spilled pale candle tallow with one or two burnt-down candle stubs each (flat wax drips, unlit, no flame), one dark soot burn mark. Row 3: three different dark branching cracks drawn on a small irregular bit of grey stone, one small group of broken stone chips. Row 4: one soft drift of grey dust, one coil of old rusty iron chain lying flat, one torn scrap of dirty grey linen shroud, one dark old water stain. Background: perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere outside the objects (it is keyed out to transparency): no shadow, no gradient, no floor, no texture on the magenta, and no magenta or pink tones inside the objects. Every object fits fully inside its own cell with a clear magenta margin and never touches the cell border or another object. Style: hand-painted stylized game art matching the attached reference tiles exactly (same brush style, low detail, large simple shapes, subdued dungeon palette, nothing saturated or bright), flat even lighting from above, no cast shadows on the background, no text, no labels, no grid lines drawn. Not gory: old dry bones only, no blood, no flesh.
